title: Ragnarok M: Eternal Love(ROM)
meta_description: Full Class Assembly, [Martial Saint] has arrived!
full_description: [Introduction]Dear adventurers:In "Ragnarok M: Eternal Love", with the debut of the new class - Martial Saint in August, we have completed the development of all classes of the original PC build. You can experience the complete class system from the original RO in ROM.- All classes are here, the [Martial Saint] arrives!With the debut of the new class Martial Saint, all classes of the original PC build have been developed. The Adventurers can now experience the complete class system from the original RO in ROM.Martial Saint Class: He possesses the ancient martial art skill from Meteor Forest. Drawing the power from the Sun, the Moon, and the Stars, he can change his combat stance based on the changes in the Rotation of Sun and Moon. He can also activate the Horoscope and unleash the Fury of Stars- Brand New Mode [Void Territory], go to Dimension Rift!Void Territory is in the temporal influx after Dimension Rift. It is the place where the most notorious and evil MVPs from all over the world are kept inAdventurers, please accept the invitation from the Void Warden and teach these MVPs a lesson!
